_comment: STRUCTURE axis scope: which real-Word tabs (word_ribbon_inventory.json) map to which clone tabs (WC.RIBBON / contextual defs). excluded_idmso = deliberate, user-signed scope-outs ONLY — every exclusion needs a reason; do not add entries just to make the ledger green.

pinned_matches._comment: human-triaged clone cmd -> Word idMso pairs the fuzzy matcher can't see (synonym labels). A pinned pair whose labels differ is reported as label-differs — Word's label is the ground truth.
